verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only in passing that Rootly incidents carry roles: Ask Rootly AI is grounded in an incident's "roles," and AI summaries draw on "action items." Nothing documents defining specific roles such as commander or comms lead, or attaching task checklists to live incidents. missing for 10: documented configurable incident roles (commander, comms lead), role assignment flow, in-incident task checklists, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: a read-only chat grounded in that incident's live timeline, roles, alerts, severity, and status
